headline: Argentine Oil Stocks Decline in New York Amid Falling Crude Prices
summary: Shares of Argentine oil companies YPF, Vista, and Pampa dropped up to 8.5% in Wall Street trading following an 8.4% drop in Brent crude to $95 per barrel.
why: Energy companies derive a significant portion of their revenues from global commodity prices, making their equity valuations sensitive to fluctuations in crude oil benchmarks.

impacts.name: YPF
impacts.why: Lower oil prices directly reduce the profit margins and asset valuations of upstream exploration and production companies.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A sharp drop in global crude oil prices directly impairs the projected cash flows of upstream oil producers.
